en.text: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

footnotes.text: 1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 大流士王第二年六月初一日，耶和华的话借先知哈该向犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚说：

zhTraditional.text: 大流士王第二年六月初一日，耶和華的話藉先知哈該向猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞說：

en.text: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”

zhSimplified.text: 万军之耶和华如此说：「这百姓说，建造耶和华殿的时候尚未来到。」

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「這百姓說，建造耶和華殿的時候尚未來到。」

en.text: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 那时耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：

zhTraditional.text: 那時耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：

en.text: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

zhSimplified.text: 「这殿仍然荒凉，你们自己还住天花板的房屋吗？

zhTraditional.text: 「這殿仍然荒涼，你們自己還住天花板的房屋嗎？

en.text: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

zhSimplified.text: 现在万军之耶和华如此说：你们要省察自己的行为。

zhTraditional.text: 現在萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要省察自己的行為。

en.text: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

zhSimplified.text: 你们撒的种多，收的却少；你们吃，却不得饱；喝，却不得足；穿衣服，却不得暖；得工钱的，将工钱装在破漏的囊中。」

zhTraditional.text: 你們撒的種多，收的卻少；你們吃，卻不得飽；喝，卻不得足；穿衣服，卻不得暖；得工錢的，將工錢裝在破漏的囊中。」

en.text: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

zhSimplified.text: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你们要省察自己的行为。

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「你們要省察自己的行為。

en.text: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要上山取木料，建造这殿，我就因此喜乐，且得荣耀。这是耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要上山取木料，建造這殿，我就因此喜樂，且得榮耀。這是耶和華說的。

en.text: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

footnotes.text: 1:9 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 你们盼望多得，所得的却少；你们收到家中，我就吹去。这是为什么呢？因为我的殿荒凉，你们各人却顾自己的房屋。这是万军之耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 你們盼望多得，所得的卻少；你們收到家中，我就吹去。這是為甚麼呢？因為我的殿荒涼，你們各人卻顧自己的房屋。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。

en.text: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

zhSimplified.text: 所以为你们的缘故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土产。

zhTraditional.text: 所以為你們的緣故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土產。

en.text: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

zhSimplified.text: 我命干旱临到地土、山冈、五谷、新酒，和油，并地上的出产、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切劳碌得来的。」

zhTraditional.text: 我命乾旱臨到地土、山岡、五穀、新酒，和油，並地上的出產、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切勞碌得來的。」

en.text: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，都听从耶和华—他们 神的话和先知哈该奉耶和华—他们 神差来所说的话；百姓也在耶和华面前存敬畏的心。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下的百姓，都聽從耶和華－他們上帝的話和先知哈該奉耶和華－他們上帝差來所說的話；百姓也在耶和華面前存敬畏的心。

en.text: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的使者哈该奉耶和华差遣对百姓说：「耶和华说：我与你们同在。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的使者哈該奉耶和華差遣對百姓說：「耶和華說：我與你們同在。」

en.text: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华激动犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下之百姓的心，他们就来为万军之耶和华—他们 神的殿做工。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華激動猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下之百姓的心，他們就來為萬軍之耶和華－他們上帝的殿做工。

en.text: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

zhSimplified.text: 这是在大流士王第二年六月二十四日。

zhTraditional.text: 這是在大流士王第二年六月二十四日。
